thag5.1:1.1: Catukkanipāto niṭṭhito. PAÑCANIPĀTO. Bhikkhu sīvathikaṃ gantvā addasaṃ itthim ujjhitaṃ apaviddhaṃ susānasmiṃ khajjantiṃ kimihī phuṭaṃ. || ||
thag5.1:2.1: yaṃ hi eke jigucchanti mataṃ disvāna pāpakaṃ, kāmarāgo pāturahū, andho va savatī ahuṃ. || ||
thag5.1:3.1: oraṃ odanapākamhā tamhā ṭhānā apakkamiṃ; satimā sampajāno 'haṃ ekamantaṃ upāvisiṃ.
